_legacy_note: 2026-09-08-nfl-01 carries pregame_public=true. That card was published in plaintext to this public repository on 2026-09-11, before the premium withholding control existed. Its selection, price, book and stake were publicly readable before kickoff. The commitment itself is unaffected - the sha256 and committed_utc are the originals - but premium exclusivity did not hold for Week 1 and the record says so rather than pretending otherwise. The flag exists ONLY to keep the renderer honest about an already-public card; it is never set on a card that was actually withheld.
_note: Per-pick fingerprints for the D.J. Mercer Spotlight. Each entry is the SHA-256 of one pick's canonical JSON, stamped when `mercer.py commit` first saw it. Append-only: a pick is never re-stamped. The grader books a pick only if its EARLIEST stamp matches the pick as it stands now AND precedes kickoff; otherwise the entry is VOID (never stamped, or stamped late) or REFUSED (edited after stamping). The git history of this file is the public timestamp.
